messages:
incident-bot: SEV-2 alert: elevated 502/504s for tenant bergman-enterprises on Dedicated pool dp-eu-central-1-02. Error rate 502/504 = 14% over 4m (SLO 0.5%). Paging @jordan (oncall). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-network-issues

jordan: ack — taking. looking at network & ingress. pulling recent config + recent deploys for that tenant.

kevin: I see a flapping link between host-h12 and svc-proxy-3 in dp-eu-central-1-02. kernel logs show repeated netlink resets around 07:08. kube endpoints for bergman backend are bouncing. other tenants on same pool show normal endpoint counts.

nicole-ops: adding quick mitigation: enabling per-tenant sticky routing to healthy hosts for bergman to avoid bouncing during DNS/endpoint churn. applying now.

deploy-bot: Sticky routing policy apply job 11234 started by nicole-ops.

oliver-cs: CSM got ping from Bergman: some enterprise customers saw "service unavailable" on their dashboards. They want a statement and to schedule urgent postmortem with their infra team. Also asking about potential data exposure since they're VPC-connected.

jordan: confirming no ingress logs show cross-tenant egress. VPC peerings unaffected; we isolated the tenant routing so traffic stays within their dedicated pool. No data exfil detected.

kevin: quick triage: host-h12 NIC firmware seems to be rebooting intermittently. I'm cordoning host-h12 and migrating bergman shards off it. /host cordon host-h12 -> success. starting migrate-shards bergman -> in-flight.

nicole-ops: autoscaler temporarily increased capacity for pool to help migrations. monitoring p95.

deploy-bot: migration job 11235 created by kevin. status: in-progress.

jordan: metrics after sticky routing + migrate: 502s down to 3.7% and still trending. p95 dropped from 2.8s -> 380ms. good sign.

kevin: host-h12 is out of rotation and rebooted; appears NIC firmware crashed on link failover. I've flagged host for hardware maintenance and moved its VMs. filing INF-7138.

oliver-cs: please prepare a short customer note for Bergman. They asked specifically: timeline, impact window, confirmation of tenant isolation, and proposed credit.

jordan: drafting now. will keep it concise.

jordan: ```
Hi Bergman infra team — quick update: between ~07:06–07:32 UTC we saw elevated 502/504 errors for bergman-enterprises on dp-eu-central-1-02 due to an intermittent NIC/host failure (host-h12). Mitigations applied: we cordoned the host, migrated your shards, and applied sticky routing to minimize retries. Impact: some requests returned 502/504; a subset of users experienced transient failures. Scope: incident was limited to your tenant on the dedicated pool; other customers were not impacted. Data safety: we found no indicators of data exposure. Next steps: 1) hardware replacement scheduled; 2) full RCA within 48h with technical timeline and follow-ups; 3) proposed SLA credit: one day of reserved capacity credit for the affected window (proposal subject to review). Contact: oliver-cs@redwood to schedule postmortem call.
```

nicole-ops: LGTM. i'd add the exact impact window (07:06–07:32 UTC) in the heading and mention we proactively increased capacity during mitigation.

jordan: updated and sent to customer. oliver-cs confirmed receipt and requested a meeting slot at 10:00 CET tomorrow.

kevin: for the internal RCA draft: root cause appears to be firmware-level NIC crash under concurrent SR-IOV configuration + recent kernel patch we rolled last week. hypothesis: kernel's netlink handling regresses under specific SR-IOV driver path.

jordan: assigning action items:
- ACTION-1: blocklist current kernel/firmware combo for dedicated pools until patch validated (owner: kevin) — ticket INF-7139
- ACTION-2: hardware repair/replacement for host-h12 and validation run (owner: ops-hardware) — ticket HW-2241
- ACTION-3: customer-facing RCA and exec note (owner: oliver-cs & jordan) — deliverable in 48h
- ACTION-4: add per-tenant network-health alert (owner: nicole-ops) — PR in 72h

kevin: i've filed INF-7139 and started a canary validation on dp-eu-central-1-03 with SR-IOV stress tests.

deploy-bot: INF-7139 created and linked to host blocks.

oliver-cs: Bergman asked about SLA credits math. Quick calc we propose: credit = min(1 day reserved fee, proportional to impacted capacity share * duration). For example, if they had 10% of pool reserved for 26 minutes -> credit = 10% * (26/1440) * reserved_fee. I'll prepare a spreadsheet.

jordan: please include wording that final credit is subject to SLA terms and exec sign-off.

nicole-ops: oncall handoff: i'm taking monitoring ownership at 08:05 UTC — will watch the pool and verify no regression overnight.

jordan: thanks — handing to nicole-ops at 08:05. nicole, i'm leaving the internal notes and the draft RCA in INC-2031.

kevin: internal RCA ETA: 48h. will include kernel logs, NIC firmware traces, and mitigation checklist.

oliver-cs: i'll prep the executive summary for the account exec and legal check for wording around exposure/no-exposure. also scheduling the customer postmortem.

jordan: incident INC-2031 created: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity Sev-2.

nicole-ops: all good for now; p95 stable ~400ms and 502s at 0.6%. closing paging loop but will reopen if we see regressions. :white_check_mark:

kevin: thanks team. I'll update INF-7138/7139 with HW and kernel timelines.

oliver-cs: end of thread — will post the RCA draft to #postmortems and loop in the exec team once kevin's technical section is in.

jordan: good job everyone.
